capabilities: detect Windows drive and UNC paths in Live Preview, Source mode, and Reading View
open files in their default Windows application and folders in File Explorer
reveal a path's parent folder and select the item
copy detected paths from the context menu
prompt for confirmation before opening executables or UNC shares
disambiguation: Not about wiki-style links between notes; it makes local Windows and UNC file paths clickable.
extras: Built and tested exclusively on Windows desktop; the README states it has not been tested on macOS or Linux. Inline code and fenced code blocks are intentionally ignored.
problem: Obsidian only links notes and file:// URLs, so plain Windows paths like C:\... or \\server\share pasted into notes are inert text that cannot be clicked to open.
summary: Detects Windows drive and UNC network paths in notes and opens files in the default app or folders in File Explorer.
